skill.name: email-quality-auditor
skill.description: Audits email programs and pre-send campaigns using SEND scoring, red-line veto checks, and a SHIP/FIX/BLOCK decision.
skill.summary: Pre-send SEND scoring and SHIP/FIX/BLOCK gating for email programs.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives from Markdown backticks and fixed relative documentation links. Confirmed risks are limited to optional connector command use, a runtime GitHub reference fetch, mutable remote instruction dependencies, and persistent audit artifacts.

remediation.issue: Optional connector commands run local Python scripts with domains or contact identifiers.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation, validate identifiers, and document read-only scopes before running connector commands.

remediation.issue: Standalone mode can fetch mutable reference instructions from GitHub raw URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle required references with the skill or pin remote fetches to immutable commit URLs.

remediation.issue: Audit outputs and verdict summaries are saved to memory paths.
remediation.suggestion: Ask before persisting artifacts and minimize sensitive consent, suppression, revenue, and contact data in saved summaries.

remediation.issue: Many fixed cross-repository links use parent-directory traversal syntax.
remediation.suggestion: Package referenced files with the skill or use marketplace-safe reference paths to reduce scanner noise.

content.value_statement: Email teams need a clear pre-send decision before campaigns risk deliverability, consent, or claim problems. This skill reviews exported evidence and produces a SEND score with SHIP, FIX, or BLOCK guidance.
actual_capabilities: Scores Sender-integrity, Engagement, Nurture, and Direct-response with goal-specific SEND weights.
Checks S1, S2, N1, and D1 red-line vetoes before send decisions.
Reviews exported ESP, DMARC, inbox-placement, GA4, ecommerce, and consent evidence.
Produces SHIP, FIX, or BLOCK guidance with a structured handoff summary.
Supports a fast go/no-go checklist before broadcasts or flow activation.
limitations: Requires user-supplied exports or pasted evidence for reliable scoring.
Marks missing critical evidence as NEEDS_INPUT instead of passing by default.
Does not configure authentication, consent systems, lifecycle flows, or creative assets.
SEND bands are provisional until calibrated against more real audits.

use_cases.title: Pre-Send Broadcast Review
use_cases.description: Check a promotional campaign for authentication, consent, unsubscribe, claims, and performance risks before launch.

use_cases.title: Deliverability Health Audit
use_cases.description: Review ESP, DMARC, inbox-placement, bounce, complaint, and reputation evidence for a sending program.

use_cases.title: Lifecycle Flow Gate
use_cases.description: Validate an automated email flow before activation, including cadence, segmentation, opt-out handling, and claims.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this email campaign before send. Goal is promotional. I can provide ESP export, DMARC report, consent record, inbox test, and GA4 export.

prompt_templates.title: Run Go-No-Go
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a pre-send go/no-go for tomorrow's broadcast. Review authentication, consent, unsubscribe, suppression, links, claims, cadence, and send-time evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Score Program Health
prompt_templates.prompt: Score this email program using SEND. Goal is retention. Use my ESP flow export, DMARC RUA, inbox-placement report, consent record, and revenue export.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Blocked Send
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this failed send gate. Identify which vetoes triggered, explain the user-facing risk, and recommend the next owner skill for each fix.

output_examples.input: Promotional broadcast with ESP metrics, DMARC RUA, inbox placement, consent record, and GA4 orders.
output: Verdict: FIX. Authentication is verifiable, but unsubscribe proof is incomplete before send.
The report lists evidence gaps, highest-risk fixes, and the next owner for remediation.

output_examples.input: Newsletter program with ESP export, consent record, inbox report, and missing ecommerce export.
output: Verdict: SHIP with concerns. Core sending controls pass, while revenue evidence is marked as unavailable.
The audit states the retention goal column and summarizes Sender-integrity, Engagement, Nurture, and Direct-response scores.

output_examples.input: Cold outbound send with missing consent records and unverifiable authentication evidence.
output: Verdict: BLOCK. The send lacks required proof for opt-in and authentication.
The handoff routes consent issues to consent-registry and authentication issues to deliverability-qa.

best_practices: Provide exports from the source systems instead of summarized screenshots.
State the campaign goal before scoring so the correct SEND weights apply.
Re-run the audit after fixing any veto or no-go item.
anti_patterns: Do not treat missing DMARC, consent, or unsubscribe proof as a pass.
Do not use ESP self-reported revenue as the only conversion truth set.
Do not hide internal veto IDs in user-facing reports without translating the risk.

faq.question: What does this skill audit?
faq.answer: It audits email program readiness using SEND scoring, red-line vetoes, and a SHIP, FIX, or BLOCK decision.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide ESP exports, DMARC RUA, inbox-placement evidence, GA4 or ecommerce exports, consent records, and the campaign goal.

faq.question: Can it fix deliverability setup?
faq.answer: No. It identifies deliverability issues and routes setup fixes to a dedicated deliverability skill.

faq.question: Can it approve a campaign with missing evidence?
faq.answer: No. Missing critical evidence becomes NEEDS_INPUT or a no-go item, depending on the context.

faq.question: Does it use live ESP APIs?
faq.answer: Manual exports are the primary source. Optional connector checks are described for limited read-only evidence.

faq.question: What happens after a BLOCK verdict?
faq.answer: Clear the failed vetoes with the owning skill or team, then re-run the audit before sending.
